body:
Changing the definition to `additionalProperties: true` provides an easier situation to deal with (i.e. the validation logic generated does nothing and I can do my own additional validation as a work around)

Example:

```
  configCreate:
    type: object
    description: A config create object
    required:
      - name
      - typeId
      - data
    properties:
      tags:
        $ref: '#/definitions/tags'
      name:
        type: string
      typeId:
        type: string
      data:
        type: object
        x-nullable: false
        additionalProperties: true
```

`x-nullable` still does nothing and generates the following validation logic:
```
func (m *ConfigCreate) validateData(formats strfmt.Registry) error {

	return nil
}
```

Work around validation logic to check for a nil `data` property and `data` is an object:

```
	if _, ok := params.Body.Data.(map[string]interface{}); !ok {
		ctx := middleware.MatchedRouteFrom(rc.Request)
		api.ServeErrorFor(ctx.Operation.ID)(rw, r, errors.InvalidType("data", "body", "object", params.Body.Data))
		return
	}
	if params.Body.Data== nil {
		ctx := middleware.MatchedRouteFrom(rc.Request)
		api.ServeErrorFor(ctx.Operation.ID)(rw, r, errors.Required("data", "body"))
		return
	}
```
The same behavior appears in v0.24.0

I think there is a minProperties you can use to this end.
https://swagger.io/docs/specification/data-models/data-types/

Looking at the go-swagger doc: https://goswagger.io/use/models/schemas.html

It says 

> minProperties, maxProperties are not supported

I didn't even try them as it is documented as not a feature.
yeah sorry If forgot it's not implemented

issue.title: Marking dictionary objects as required is ignored in generated code

issue.title: Fixed missing Required validations
issue.body:
Addresses missing "required" validation in some cases:
- when schema is mapped as an interface{} (e.g. additionalProperties: true)
- when schema is a mapped as a map[string]interface{} (e.g. additionalProperties: type: object)
- when schema is an aliased primitive type produced by a $ref

We compare the value to nil instead of calling `validate.Required()` whenever the type is `interface{}`.
Same for `validate.IsZero()`.

* fixes #2081 [required interface{}]
* fixes #2300 [required map[string]interface{}]
* fixes #2381 [required ref'ed primitive]
* fixes #2415 [duplicate of #2300]

Signed-off-by: Frederic BIDON <fredbi@yahoo.com>
